name: Paneer Burrito

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Rinse rice and boil with 320 ml water and 2 g salt. Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat for 10 minutes.
Dice paneer and pepper. Slice half the onion; cook with pepper in 15 ml oil for 4 minutes. Add paneer, cumin, paprika and 2 g salt; cook for 4 minutes.
Add black beans and remaining 40 ml water; simmer for 3 minutes until hot and nearly dry.
Finely dice tomato and remaining onion. Mix with chopped coriander, lime juice and remaining 2 g salt; drain excess salsa liquid.
Warm 4 large tortillas. Divide rice, paneer-bean filling, cheese and salsa among them. Fold the sides inward and roll snugly, keeping the filling enclosed.
Use remaining 10 ml oil to toast burritos in a skillet for 2 minutes per side, starting seam-side down, until lightly golden and cheese melts.
tips: Use large tortillas and keep the filling away from their edges for a neat seal.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
